STACK.name: Directus
STACK.does: Admin over the app tables (users, journey state, financial record, plan versions, AA consents, ops queue) with roles, permissions and an activity log. Also the CMS: videos, FAQs, tooltips, disclaimers, sample plans, agreements templates, app config and SKU cards.

STACK.name: Metabase
STACK.does: The KPI dashboard and every count in the doc that comes from the database: users, paid, plans, AUA, SIP book, AA availed, integration failures. Scheduled email of the dashboard.
STACK.notes: SQL questions saved once; nobody builds a dashboard screen.

STACK.name: Mixpanel
STACK.does: Behaviour: funnels, retention, drop-off by screen. Every wireframe screen ID is an event.
STACK.notes: If the free tier is outgrown, the same events can be stored in the database and read in Metabase with less convenience.

STACK.name: Razorpay dashboard
STACK.does: Payments, subscriptions, mandates, refunds, invoices. Source of truth for money.
STACK.notes: Webhooks update tier and billing state in the app; Metabase mirrors counts.

STACK.name: Digio console
STACK.does: KYC fetch (KRA/CKYC) and Aadhaar eSign records.
STACK.notes: Signed PDFs are copied into the vault (H06).

STACK.name: AA TSP console (Setu / Finvu / OneMoney)
STACK.does: Consent templates, consent status, FIP health, fetch logs.
STACK.notes: AA failure rate reads from here and from the app's integration log.

STACK.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging
STACK.does: Push notifications. Text lives in the app config table so it is editable without a release.

STACK.name: Sentry + uptime monitor
STACK.does: Errors and integration failures with alerts. Replaces the doc's Integrations table.

STACK.name: Logic panel (built)
STACK.does: Assumptions, cohort grid, instrument universe, market inputs, staging, publish, audit (L01 to L08).
